text.en: Fictional sample event: the fictional issuer announced a mock robot-arm order from an unnamed carmaker.
text.id: Peristiwa contoh fiksi: penerbit fiktif mengumumkan pesanan lengan robot pura-pura dari produsen mobil yang tidak disebutkan.
text.zh: 虚构样本事件：该虚构发行人宣布获得一家未具名车企的模拟机械臂订单。

text.en: Fictional sample report: the fictional issuer filed a mock half-year result with profit propped up by a one-off subsidy.
text.id: Laporan contoh fiksi: penerbit fiktif melaporkan hasil semester pura-pura dengan laba ditopang subsidi satu kali.
text.zh: 虚构样本报告：该虚构发行人提交模拟半年业绩，利润由一次性补贴支撑。
